race.comment: SACRED WELL (10) started favourite and appeared to have every chance but lacked a change of gears last start when he just missed the placings over 1500m at Port Macquarie. Drawn to enjoy the run of the race and should be close to peak fitness at the third run of the campaign. TORMANZOR (7) is back after a 23-week spell. Found some form late last prep when tested over staying trips. Has trialled twice leading into this return. The mile looks a very nice starting point. WHAT A GENT (8) has been in work forever but keeps earning pay cheques for connections. Good effort two back when beaten narrowly over 1400m here. Has placed here at the mile but after 26 starts without a win the enthusiasm is mild. ATADCHEEKY (1) recorded a fifth career minor placing recently when he found the line well to be beaten under a length over today's journey at Coffs Harbour. Will be in the finish again with a similar performance today. KING KALAKAUA (3) should be ready to find his best third-up.
